description:
Use this when the user wants to search a long video for a topic by meaning before clipping: "where do I talk
        about the new game", "find the funny bits", "when did chat go wild", "find the part about speedruns".
        project_id: from list_projects; topic: what to look for, in plain words. Returns job_id at once; when job_status says done, get_moments gives up to count matches (1-10, each min_seconds to
        max_seconds long, default 20 to 60) as time ranges with a quote. The user picks; clip_range cuts one, find_clips
        (with topic) cuts several.
        Not for: cutting clips straight away (find_clips, clip_range) or finding a video by its name (search). Spends
        Horizon Units, as much as reading the whole video: call estimate_hu for the same project first, show the number
        and pass the approved amount as max_hu (a higher cost is refused; a failed search gives it back). The same
        video analysed once is not charged again. request_key is optional.
name: find_moments
title: Find moments
